# Archived starter examples

`Aa_SampleTC.java.example` and `Aa_SamplePage.java.example` preserve the original generic sample-screen examples. They target a different screen, use legacy naming/groups and are not compiled or selected by application suites.

For new application tests, use [the current writing guide](../test-writing-guide.md) and the standard classes under `src/test/java/documenteditor` and `src/test/java/portal`. These archived examples are historical references, not the current naming/grouping template.
